invariant_argument: Raw serde schemas/reports/witnesses are not admitted certificates. FdSchema is revalidated by each public decision. deny_unknown_fields only restricts serialized structure;closure verify replays all derivations. Level3 reflects bounded FD/set algorithms,not a database/category architecture.

After heading admission every bitset lies in 8-bit finite heading. Public closure input and witness input/result are checked. A close application has determinant subset current and adds at least one bit. Induction gives input subset current subset every closed superset of input;terminal full stable scan makes current closed,so it is the least closure. Saved indices strictly grow,at most8. Verifier derives the same two inclusions for any accepted strict index sequence,not just producer order. Lean accepted_exact proves this abstract replay theorem;Rust bitwise/serde/storage mapping is this source argument and independent closed-superset native enumeration.

Projection descending subset iteration is exact:for nonzero subset,(subset-1)&component visits the next lower component subset;0 is processed before stopping,so no underflow. For each subset X,closureF(X) intersect component supplies all newly implied component attributes. Nontrivial projection entry iff difference nonempty;BCNF violation iff that closure is not entire component. These exact projected entries form a complete equivalent cover for component-restricted implications because the entry for each determinant contains all its implied component attributes. A determinant whose entire closure equals itself needs no entry.

For binary FD losslessness,the intersection closure determines a component exactly by subset test;first component is selected on ties. Sufficiency is Lean lossless_left/right under cover and row FD assumptions. Necessity source argument over unrestricted two-value relations:if neither component lies in C=closure(intersection),use all-zero row a and row b equal0 on C and1 elsewhere. Closedness of C makes every original FD hold for the pair. A join row choosing a on component0 and b on component1 is well-defined because intersection subset C,and differs from both original rows because each component has a coordinate outside C. Thus some satisfying instance has a spurious join tuple. Empty/current instances do not establish schema membership,and no arbitrary current finite value domain guarantees the counterexample values exist.

Every projected implication follows from original closure,so the union projected cover is entailed by original. It preserves original FD theory iff every original generator dependent is contained in its determinant closure under that union. That is exactly lost_dependencies;duplicate generators and order remain raw report data. Internal cover can have510nontrivial entries and must not use public128 cap. Shared Work charges subset admission plus each original/internal FD inspection including terminal scans,regardless of enabledness. Source extraction only moves old loops into helpers,leaving exact call and charge order;frozen reference/native budgets compare full reports and every tested refusal. At each spend,used<=limit;successful used<limit makes u64increment safe even MAX. Failure drops only temporary local state.

Instance shape ensures every indexed row has arity<=8;original dependency masks already admitted. Set duplicate test uses lawful Ord consistent with Eq. Pair traversal is dependency,first,second ascending;rows_agree preserves original selected Eq order. Projection and join preserve exact original coordinate order and set semantics. Join preflight computes indices in0..arity and validates cover,both row widths before all pair indexing. Shared layout pairs point within admitted widths,and output columns cover each original attribute once. Attribute lookup chooses left on overlaps and checked right otherwise. Generic Eq/Ord must be equivalence/total order compatible and Clone value-preserving;callbacks/allocations can panic and no arbitrary-T purity/crash guarantee is made.

All old public signatures and result/error variants remain unchanged. Source changes are docs,loop extraction and pure cached usize join layout. Old and new calls to T equality/clone occur in the same row/coordinate order under these lawful trait assumptions;standard usize layout computations have no user T callbacks. No redundant row/payload clones or position scans occur within pair loops. Required projected-record clone feeds two distinct owned outputs;lost original FD clones and required T row clones remain. Max output16384rows of <=8values;payload byte size and allocator/runtime bound are not inferred. fmt write! has one formatting delegation and no hidden domain branch. Derived serde/Debug/Clone/Eq code is compiler/library TCB,not counted as expanded AST.
